sections.title: Hook
sections.text: Football is already social. But most digital match experiences still leave every fan watching alone. VIRA turns one football match into a shared experience, before, during, and after kickoff.

sections.title: Match Preview
sections.text: Every journey starts in Match Preview. Fans see the fixture, kickoff, market context, and the experiences currently available — all continuously updated from TxLINE data.

sections.title: VIRA Picks
sections.text: Before kickoff, VIRA Picks lets fans make structured match predictions using supported TxLINE market observations. Here, the fan selects the match result and the regular-time total goals line. Consensus is shown only for each individual selection. VIRA never calculates a combined probability, and no money, stake, payout, or wagering is involved.

sections.title: Immutable card and share
sections.text: Once confirmed, the Picks card becomes immutable. The server preserves the exact market snapshots observed at confirmation, including freshness, provider context, and canonical hashes. The fan can now share a clear, visual card with friends.

sections.title: Friend journey
sections.text: A friend opens the shared link and sees the original card without receiving private credentials or session data. They can join the same social group, create their own predictions, and confirm a separate card under their own identity.

sections.title: Server-owned kickoff lock
sections.text: At kickoff, every card is locked by the server. The browser cannot extend the deadline, reopen a card, or change a confirmed selection. The fixture authority always controls whether new predictions are accepted.

sections.title: Match Room
sections.text: As the match moves live, the experience continues inside the VIRA Match Room. TxLINE match events, scores, market movement, and live football signals are normalized into a shared consumer experience. Fans can follow attacking pressure, defensive pressure, possession shifts, and the moments that change the match.

sections.title: Competitive round
sections.text: When an eligible signal opens a round, both participants receive the same question and the same authoritative deadline. Each answer remains private until the server locks the round. No participant can inspect another fan’s choice before that lock.

sections.title: Resolution and ranking
sections.text: The official TxLINE observation resolves the round for everyone. The same deterministic rule produces the result, updates the isolated competitive ledger, and refreshes the Mini League ranking across both screens.

sections.title: Post-match experience
sections.text: After the final result, VIRA resolves each supported Pick independently from the authoritative regular-time score. Fans receive a simple summary, see which reads were correct, missed, or void, and can share the result without financial language.

sections.title: Judge Evaluation Guide
sections.text: Live football is not required to evaluate VIRA. The Judge Evaluation Guide provides direct access to VIRA Picks, the live product, and a certified playback reconstructed through the production runtime.

sections.title: TxLINE evidence chain
sections.text: The evidence chain remains visible: a TxLINE provider observation is normalized, persisted, locked by the server, processed by a deterministic rule, and reproduced from the append-only event history. The public projection exposes the fixture context, provider sequence, timestamps, rule, result, and verification hashes — without exposing credentials.

sections.title: Commercial path
sections.text: VIRA is free and accessible for fans, while creating a reusable engagement layer for clubs, broadcasters, sponsors, communities, and sports platforms.

sections.title: Outro
sections.text: One match. Two social experiences. Powered by TxLINE. This is VIRA.
